messages.subject: Recoding response categories for GRM
parts:
Hello all,

Thanks for all the help so far! 

I am analyzing some questionnaire data (respondents = 191, items = 18, response categories 1-5) using GRM. First, I used the nominal model to investigate category order and noted that there are two out-of-order categories for items 1 and 15. Item 1 = 1,2,4,3,5, and item 15 = 1,3,2,4,5. The number of responses per category, while not mind-blowing, are at least > 20.

I would like to try two things: (a) reorder the categories for items 1 and 15, and (b) collapse the disordered categories for each item. What's the code to do this?

#-- THE DATA
    
    QData <- read.delim("QData.txt")
    names(QData) <- c( paste("Q", 1:18, sep = ""))
    head(QData)

#-- MISSING DATA
    
    QMiss <- QData
    QMiss[QMiss == -9] <- NA
    head(QMiss)

#-- NOMINAL MODEL (NOM) FOR CATEGORY-ORDER CHECK
    
    # Item 1: Q1
    
    QMiss.NOM <- mirt(QMiss, 1, itemtype = c( rep("nominal", 1), 
                                              rep("graded", 17))) 
    coef(QMiss.NOM, printSE = T)
    
    # Item 15: Q15
    
    QMiss.NOM <- mirt(QMiss, 1, itemtype = c( rep("graded", 14), 
                                              rep("nominal", 1),
                                              rep("graded", 3)))
    coef(QMiss.NOM, printSE = T)

#-- FIT THE GRADED RESPONSE MODEL (GRM)
    
    QMiss.GRM <- mirt(QMiss, 1, itemtype = "graded", SE = T)
      coef(QMiss.GRM, printSE = T)

Probably just replacing that item with reordered categories would work. So something like 

item <- data[,1]
item <- ifelse(data[,1] == 4, 3, item) 
item <- ifelse(data[,1] == 3, 4, item)
data[,1] <- item
and (b) collapse the disordered categories for each item. What's the code to do this?
